title: Odoo Implementation Lead / Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Odoo Implementation Lead** to drive our ERP implementation projects and support our growing team. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, mentor junior functional consultants/business analysts, and act as a strategic point of contact for clients.

This is a dynamic, "playing coach" role ideal for a senior functional expert who wants to lead a team while staying close to the Odoo ecosystem, assisting with complex client requirements, pre-sales demos, and resource optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project Delivery & Governance:** Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of Odoo implementation projects, ensuring milestones are met on time, within scope, and up to quality standards.
* **Team Leadership & Mentoring:** Direct, guide, and upskill a team of junior functional consultants and business analysts, fostering their professional growth.
* **Training Management:** Design and lead functional training programs for internal team members and clients during project onboarding or rollouts.
* **Pre-Sales & Complex Demos:** Provide senior-level functional support during the sales cycle, stepping in to lead demonstrations for complex workflows or high-value client prospects.
* **Client Relationship & Account Health:** Serve as a primary point of contact for project clients. Conduct monthly/regular review meetings for project delivery and employee augmentation accounts to ensure high client satisfaction and resource performance.
* **Resource Allocation:** Optimize team utilization across dedicated implementation projects and resource augmentation assignments.

\*

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in Odoo ERP implementation, with a proven track record of successful end-to-end rollouts.
* **Odoo Expertise:** Deep, comprehensive functional knowledge of core Odoo modules (e.g., Accounting, Inventory, Manufacturing, CRM, Sales, Purchase).
* **Leadership Skills:** Prior experience leading, mentoring, or managing functional consultants or business analysts.
* **Communication:** Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage client expectations, handle escalations, and deliver technical presentations clearly.
* **Methodology:** Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or traditional) tailored to ERP delivery cycles.

Pay: Up to ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have leading end-to-end Odoo ERP implementations as a Project Lead or Functional Consultant?"
* "Which versions of Odoo (e.g., v15, v16, v17, v18) have you successfully deployed, and have you ever led a major version upgrade project?"
* Have you directly managed a team of internal Odoo developers and functional QA testers, or do you typically work as a solo consultant?"
* Have you independently handled an Odoo implementation from requirement gathering through Go-Live?
* Have you conducted business requirement gathering and mapped client requirements to standard Odoo functionality?

* Have you conducted Odoo product demos or presentations for prospective clients?

* What is your current/expected salary and notice period?

title: Quality Assurance (Education Sector)
description:
**Position:** Quality Analyst – Executive

**Department:** Quality Assurance (QA)  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Quality Analyst – Executive** to support our QA team in monitoring post-admission processes, verifying student records and documents, conducting verification calls, tracking compliance, coordinating with departments, and preparing accurate QA reports.

The role will work closely with the **Sales, Admissions, CRE, Accounts, Admin, Customer Success and other concerned teams** to ensure that student-related processes are completed accurately and within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor newly confirmed admissions and verify that student details are correctly updated.
* Verify student documents for completeness, accuracy and proper filing.
* Conduct student verification calls and confirm admission, course, university, fee and payment details.
* Verify Welcome Mail and Welcome Call completion within defined timelines.
* Monitor Onboard, Payment Status and University Registration records.
* Maintain and update QA trackers, verification sheets and pending-case records.
* Identify missing documents, incorrect information, process deviations and compliance gaps.
* Follow up with concerned teams and executives to close pending cases.
* Coordinate with Sales, CRE, Admin, Accounts, Admissions and Customer Success teams.
* Maintain accurate records of verification outcomes, discrepancies and escalations.
* Prepare daily, weekly and other QA reports as assigned.
* Support periodic process audits and maintain audit observations and corrective-action records.
* Escalate critical or unresolved issues to the Associate Quality Analyst.
* Maintain confidentiality of student and organizational information.
* Ensure all assigned QA activities are completed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

Required Skills

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional telephone etiquette and verification-call skills.
* Good documentation and follow-up skills.
* Basic analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Strong coordination and time-management skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and defined SOPs.
* Working knowledge of **Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Drive and documentation tools**.
* Ability to handle confidential student information appropriately.

Qualification & Experience

* **Bachelor’s degree** in any discipline.
* Experience in **Quality Assurance, Operations, Administration or Process Management** will be an advantage.

Key Performance Areas

* Accuracy of student and QA records.
* Timely verification of Welcome Mail and Welcome Calls.
* Document verification accuracy and completeness.
* Timely completion of verification calls and follow-ups.
* Identification and reporting of discrepancies.
* Timely and accurate QA reporting.
* Compliance with defined SOPs and timelines.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

* Paid time off

We are looking for passionate professionals who will be responsible for user acceptance testing of various Marketing technology products used within BMC

* Should be comfortable in a global and virtual teaming environment, should be excellent in both written and verbal communication with stakeholders across geography. (Clients are from UK)

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2+ years of UX UAT experience
* Working experience of AEM (Preferred but not essential)
* Able to demonstrate experience in UX validation, QA and/or UAT processes, methodologies and tools.
* Experience in writing and executing test cases and scripts
* Ability to interpret wireframes, design specifications, and functional requirements to validate design fidelity.
* Familiarity with mobile operating systems, browsers, and responsive design testing.
* Fluency with MS Office Tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
* Background in digital design or exposure to design workflows, with a good “design eye” to spot inconsistencies in layout, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
* Enthusiasm to learn new things in a fast-moving environment.
* Proven ability to manage time effectively, prioritize work to meet aggressive deadlines, and deliver high quality output through attention to detail.
* Comfortable in a global and virtual cross-teaming environment
* Strong verbal communication

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Ability to think strategically/end-to-end with result-oriented mindset
* Ability to build rapport within the firm and win the trust of the clients

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Content management system (AEM, Wordpress etc)
* Marketing automation platforms (Marketo, Sprinklr, Hubspot etc) - Optional
* MS Office tools (Word, Excel, IE); web/production technologies such as HTML, XML, JavaScript, and CSS

  

**What we look for**

* A professional who has technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Self-motivated individual who strives to learn new technology and help improve the existing standard testing process
* Professional who is willing to work with cross functional team to work with Product managers and EY IT team

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern
description:

### **Job Description**

Interns will gain practical exposure to intelligent test generation, defect analysis, test optimisation, and AI-driven quality assurance through industry-oriented software projects.

* Execute manual and AI-assisted software testing activities.
* Identify, document, track, and report software defects and inconsistencies.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, and compatibility testing.
* Explore AI-powered tools for test case generation, test data creation, and test result analysis.
* Assist in developing and maintaining automated test scripts.
* Use AI tools to support test coverage analysis and identify potential edge cases.
* Perform API testing and validate application responses and data accuracy.
* Evaluate AI-generated test cases for accuracy, relevance, and completeness.
* Collaborate with developers and QA engineers to investigate and resolve software defects.
* Maintain test documentation, defect reports, and quality assurance records.
* Participate in live projects involving AI-assisted testing and modern quality engineering practices.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), and testing methodologies.
* Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Familiarity with manual testing, test case design, and defect life cycle management.
* Basic understanding of test automation concepts and scripting fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI tools and Generative AI applications is preferred.
* Awareness of Selenium, Playwright, or similar automation frameworks is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman is beneficial.
* Understanding of prompt engineering for AI-assisted testing is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities.
* Interest in AI-driven software quality engineering and emerging testing technologies.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in Software Testing, Artificial Intelligence, Test Automation, and Quality Engineering are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* AI Test Engineer
* Software QA Engineer
* Test Automation Engineer
* Quality Engineering Analyst
* AI Testing Specialist
* Software Test Analyst

### **Why Join Us?**

* Next-Gen QA Stack: Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI testing tools, prompt engineering
for test automation, and Generative AI test generation.* Modern Quality Engineering: Learn how to combine traditional STLC fundamentals with AI-driven edge case discovery and automated regression testing.
* Real Project Workflows: Work alongside software developers and QA teams on production applications to streamline testing cycles.
* Future-Proof Career: Position yourself at the forefront of the software industry by mastering AI-driven quality engineering techniques early in your career.

### **Apply Now and Build Your Future in AI-Driven Software Testing!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume on hr@wahylab.com

title: AI Data Quality and Verification Associate

Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.

* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* User story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.

description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1741088
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job Title: SuccessFactors Config Lead – SF RBP**

  


**Job Summary:**

  



SuccessFactors Config Lead will have full responsibility for the delivery application end\-to\-end working with Project Manager, QA resources and Support Team.

  


**Essential Functions of the Job:**

  


* Design, configure, and maintain complex Role\-Based Permission (RBP) models in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.
* Configure and manage dynamic permission groups using employee data attributes (location, department, job classification, pay grade, employment status, custom MDF objects).
* Implement and troubleshoot granular EC permissions, including Employee Data, Employment Details, Compensation, Time\-Off, and workflow\-driven access restrictions.
* Perform detailed RBP troubleshooting, including root\-cause analysis of permission conflicts, inactive permissions, target population mismatches, and proxy access issues.
* Support security design for SuccessFactors releases, preview testing, regression validation, and post\-release remediation activities.
* Secure SuccessFactors integrations with SAP ECC/S/4HANA, SAP IDM, and third\-party systems by validating user IDs, role mappings, and provisioning logic.
* Translate detailed Requirements and Design and Solution Architecture deliverables into detailed design specifications.
* Technical deliverables on projects assigned.
* Proactively anticipate project issues before they occur, define the problem, identify possible causes, work with team to identify solutions, select and implement most appropriate solution.

  


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

  


* Demonstrate, by example, in\-depth knowledge of the EY competency principles and practices.
* Leader and team player – sets example for business analysts and others to follow.
* Create an open, honest, accountable and collaborative team environment.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

  


* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Role\-Based Permissions (RBP) across EC, ONB, RCM, LMS, PMGM and SAP Workzone etc.
* Expertise in Employee Central (EC) security, including permission roles, permission groups, target/granted populations, workflow permission group and role assignments.
* Experience on proxy management.
* Experience designing dynamic permission groups using EC attributes and MDF objects.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Onboarding 2\.0 security and EC–ONB data access alignment.
* Solid understanding of Recruiting (RCM) security and Learning (LMS) security.
* Administer IAS/IPS provisioning and SSO integrations with SuccessFactors and SAP systems.
* Strong skills in RBP troubleshooting and post\-release access issue resolution.
* Expertise in application security S4H, Fiori, HANA, SAP BTP with deep understanding of authentication, user provisioning, role design management.
* Proficiency in SAP GRC, SoD analysis, risk remediation, and audit frameworks (SOX, GDPR).
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change.
* Business Analysis experience.

  


**Other Requirements:**

  


* Excellent communication, verbal, presentation and written skills.
* Flexible and reliable\- displaying great ownership in all aspects.

  


**Job Requirements:**

  


**Education:**

  


* A degree in Computer Science and/or a business related degree; or equivalent work experience

  


**Experience:**

  


* 6\+ years of application services and/or client/supplier relationship management in a technology environment.
* Experience of working on complex RBP SAP rollout projects.
* Work experience in a professional services industry, preferred.

  


**Certification Requirements:**

  


* SAP Certified – RBP.
* SAP Successfactors Platform.
* Good to have CISSP or CompTIA security\+.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
